notes: Primary source: TSL's own PAM1 MK2 Operating Manual (Issue 3 handbook PDF), which is more complete than TSL's marketing product page. Several taxonomy/documentation ambiguities are flagged inline on individual ports: (1) no DB25 connector id exists in the given taxonomy, so the unit's two 25-way D-type audio connectors are tagged with the closest available D-sub id (rs232) purely for shape - they are audio breakout connectors, not RS232 data ports; (2) the "dual 12V DC input" redundant-power claim in the feature list could not be fully visually confirmed against the rear-panel photo (only one DC barrel jack was clearly legible); (3) the manual's "Metadata" D9 pinout (RS422 master) and the panel-printed "GPI" D9 could not be definitively confirmed as the same physical connector - they were merged as one port entry; (4) the manual also contains a D25 "Analogue Input" pinout table (channels 3-6) referenced from the spec section, but this connector does not appear on the actual PAM1 MK2 rear-panel photo/hookup schematic and was treated as leftover documentation shared across TSL's PAM product family rather than a real port on this SKU - it was NOT included in the port list. Unit is 1U, 483x280mm, 3.1kg, available in Dolby-decoding and non-Dolby versions (Dolby E/Dolby Digital/Dolby Digital Plus support is a firmware/licensing variant, not a physical port difference).

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: HD/SD-SDI input, auto-sensing 1080p (60/59.94/50), SMPTE 259M/292M/424M, 75 ohm

ports.name: SDI 2
ports.note: HD/SD-SDI input, auto-sensing 1080p (60/59.94/50), SMPTE 259M/292M/424M, 75 ohm

ports.name: AES 1
ports.note: AES3 (1994) balanced digital audio input, XLR3 female, 110 ohm, 32/44.1/48kHz

ports.name: AES 2
ports.note: AES3 (1994) balanced digital audio input, XLR3 female, 110 ohm, 32/44.1/48kHz

ports.name: IP1 A1
ports.note: Analogue balanced line input, stereo pair 1 channel 1

ports.name: IP1 A2
ports.note: Analogue balanced line input, stereo pair 1 channel 2

ports.name: IP2 A1
ports.note: Analogue balanced line input, stereo pair 2 channel 1

ports.name: IP2 A2
ports.note: Analogue balanced line input, stereo pair 2 channel 2

ports.name: AES I/O
ports.note: 25-way D-type (DB25) connector, 4 pairs/8ch AES3 in + 4 pairs/8ch AES3 out, 110 ohm, Yamaha-style pinout; optional CAB-D25-BNC breaks out to unbalanced 75-ohm BNC. No DB25 id exists in the connector taxonomy - rs232 used only as the closest D-sub shape match; this is NOT an RS232 data port.

ports.name: Analogue Out
ports.note: 25-way D-type (DB25) connector, fixed/variable analogue multichannel output, 8 mono channels (4 stereo pairs, for 5.1/7.1 loudspeaker feeds), Yamaha-style pinout. No DB25 id exists in the connector taxonomy - rs232 used only as the closest D-sub shape match; this is NOT an RS232 data port.

ports.name: O/P A1
ports.note: Analogue stereo line output, channel 1 (50 ohm, through level control)

ports.name: O/P A2
ports.note: Analogue stereo line output, channel 2 (50 ohm, through level control)

ports.name: Video Out
ports.note: User-selectable Composite video (SD PAL/NTSC) or SDI output, selected via rear DIP switch 8; grade omitted because mode is switchable between analogue composite and digital SDI

ports.name: Re-clocked Out
ports.note: Re-clocked serial digital output of the selected HD/SDI input, 75 ohm

ports.name: Ext Monitor Out
ports.note: HD-SDI output for external monitor-wall display (feature unique to MK2); can drive a 3rd-party SDI-to-HDMI/DVI converter

ports.name: Phones
ports.note: Front-panel stereo headphone jack ('Stereo Jack socket type A'), 50 ohm, with loudspeaker mute on insertion

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for firmware/system updates and preset save/recall

ports.name: RS 422
ports.note: Rear-panel D9 remote-control connector, wired for RS422 slave operation

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: Rear-panel D9. Manual's separate 'Metadata' D9 pinout table (RS422 master, TX+/TX-/RX+/RX-) appears to correspond to this physical connector, but the panel-vs-manual labeling is ambiguous in the source document.

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: 12V DC power input, powered from the supplied external 90-250VAC to 12VDC converter

ports.name: DC IN 2
ports.note: Datasheet's feature list states 'Dual 12V DC inputs' for redundant power; a second DC input is claimed by the spec text but its exact physical position could not be confirmed at the resolution of the sourced rear-panel photo/schematic.
